name: saferent
description: SafeRent Super Admin portal — React web app + Express/MySQL API, Firebase for authentication

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix server run test:migrate && npm --prefix server run test:integration
